visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, a black baseball cap, and a black t-shirt holds a white smartphone box featuring an orange device. He is positioned in a studio with vibrant red and blue backlight. Large text 'iPhone 17' is overlaid on the screen. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a wooden table where the man unboxes the orange smartphone. The device has a distinct triple-camera layout. (3) Hands peel back a white protective film from the front of the screen. (4) A cardboard packaging for the 'Rhinoshield 3D Impact Screen Protector' is held up to the camera. (5) The phone is placed into a plastic alignment frame, and the screen protector is applied with a press-and-pull motion. (6) A second package for 'Rhinoshield Lens Protectors' is shown close-up. (7) Three individual lens rings are meticulously pressed onto the camera lenses of the orange phone. (8) The man returns to the frame, holding the phone and talking enthusiastically. (9) A third package, a 'Dandadan' collaboration case box, is opened to reveal a clear case with anime character graphics. (10) The phone is snapped into the clear case, which has red side buttons. (11) Multiple close-up shots show the phone's back and sides, highlighting the orange color through the anime-themed case. (12) A screen recording shows the Rhinoshield website with various IP collaborations like Toy Story and Godzilla. (13) The man points at the viewer while holding the finished phone setup, ending the video with a final pose.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-energy male shout and fast-tempo rock music featuring distorted electric guitars. The arousal level is immediately high. (2) A loud 'thud' sound effect occurs as the phone box is placed on the table, synchronized with a visual cut. (3) Crisp, high-frequency 'plastic peeling' sounds accompany the removal of the screen film. (4) The narrator's speech rate is fast and enthusiastic, with sharp 'click' and 'snap' SFX as the alignment frame is used. (5) Multiple rhythmic 'tapping' and 'snapping' sounds are heard as the lens protectors are applied. (6) A second male voice is heard briefly in a conversational tone, followed by the sound of cardboard tearing. (7) Rapid-fire 'click' SFX signify the phone being secured into the case. (8) The music continues at a steady driving pace while the narrator explains the website options. (9) The audio ends with a punchy vocal conclusion and a final electric guitar chord.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy advertisement for Rhinoshield smartphone accessories. It uses the 'hook' of a futuristic iPhone 17 unboxing to grab attention, then provides a step-by-step demonstration of applying screen and lens protectors, concluding with a showcase of IP-collaboration cases to drive traffic to the brand's website.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of unboxing and applying multiple products from the RHINOSHIELD brand, accompanied by brand logos and website walkthrough.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a 'future tech' hook (iPhone 17) to create viral interest for current-gen protection accessories. The editing is highly optimized for short-form social media platforms with fast cuts and punchy SFX.
